about_the_game:
Return to Earth Atlantis

Prepare to dive into Earth Atlantis 2, a thrilling post-apocalyptic SHMUP with Metroidvania-style exploration, set in a vast sunken world overrun by machine-hybrid sea monsters. Pilot a heavily armed submarine through relentless bullet-hell chaos, hunting over 20 colossal bosses—from a rock-armored crab to an ancient Megalodon—in heart-pounding bullet-hell battles across 9 interconnected stages. Explore a vibrant post-apocalyptic underwater world far larger than before, spanning submerged forests, drowned New York cityscapes, ancient Egyptian pyramids, and the ruins of lost Atlantis.

With a breathtaking brand new pixel art style, Earth Atlantis 2 delivers intense bullet-hell action packed with epic sea monster showdowns, innovative drone systems, stunning visuals, and unforgettable undersea exploration.

Story

At the dawn of the 22nd century, oceans covering 96% of Earth’s surface have swallowed human civilization. Post-apocalyptic ruins lie buried in the abyss. Machines once built to serve humanity have evolved into ferocious machine-hybrid sea monsters, ruling the depths. As a legendary submarine captain, you must hunt these terrifying creatures in relentless bullet-hell clashes, uncover lost secrets beneath the abyss, and fight to save humanity.

Key Features

  • Epic Boss Battles:
    Fight over 20 colossal machine-hybrid sea monsters, each featuring intricate behaviors, unique attack patterns, and multi-stage encounters that demand sharp reflexes and precise tactics.

  • Upgraded Gameplay:
    Master the all-new Drone system, unlocking diverse formations and upgrades to suit any situation and unleashing devastating special blasts for critical strikes.

  • Vast Post-Apocalyptic Sunken World:
    Explore a sprawling free-roaming map across 9 stages, from submerged New York to sunken Egyptian pyramids and fabled Atlantis. Uncover ancient artifacts, battle machine-hybrid sea monster ambushes, and unlock powerful upgrades in a dynamic post-apocalyptic seascape of forested depths and ancient ruins.

  • Breathtaking Visuals:
    Immerse yourself in a vibrant post-apocalyptic underwater world brought to life with a stunning new pixel art style, blending retro charm with modern visual flair.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 / AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: The game may be demanding on the GPU for handling high-quality pixel art, particle effects, and shaders.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: A dedicated GPU is recommended for smooth gameplay, especially for dynamic lighting, post-processing effects, and high-quality textures.

short_description: Earth Atlantis 2 is a boss-focused shoot 'em up set in a post-apocalyptic sunken world ruled by machine sea monsters. Pilot a heavily armed sub through relentless battles against 20+ colossal bosses, explore a Metroidvania-style underwater world, and uncover lost secrets to save humanity.
